content:
maria: Eval alert — nightly run flagged long_prompt_suite regressions for model 'redwood-small-q4f16'. Failure rate 12% (24/200) vs baseline 4%. EvalBot attached summary.

eval-bot: Nightly eval summary: suite=long_prompt_suite, model=redwood-small-q4f16, failures=24/200 (12%), baseline=4%. Top failure mode: truncation / lost-instruction. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/long_prompt_suite/1752001234

alex: Can you paste a raw failing generation? want to see tokenizer/padding symptoms. :eyes:

sam: Repro command:```bash
redwood-eval run --model redwood-small-q4f16 \
  --suite long_prompt_suite --seed 42 --limit 10
```Failing sample (prompt id 4821):
Prompt: "Instruction: Summarize the document and list action items. Document: [very long doc ~5500 tokens]"
Generated: "...the document discusses the Q3 roadmap and the team should priorit-" <-- cutoff mid-word, instruction summary missing.
Runtime log excerpt: "kv_cache_eviction: triggered at step=1024; kv_reset_count=1"

cheng: We deployed the kv-cache padding/shard fix in runtime at commit a1b2c3 last night. Could be an interaction with the q4f16 memory layout. cc @ops-bot

ops-bot: Deployment note: runtime v2.11.0 rolled to prod-serving 2025-11-05T03:12Z. Model bundles unchanged. Rolling back runtime will impact Dedicated clusters (need approval).

alex: If eviction threshold moved earlier, long contexts can lose prefixes. Sam: try re-run with KV_CACHE_MAX_TOKENS=8192 or KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1 and post logs.

sam: Running KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1 now. Logs show repeated resets: "kv_reset_count=3; last_reset_reason=shard_resize; reset_offsets=[0,2048,4096]" — looks like shard resize during streaming, not just final eviction.

maria: That matches the failures — instructions from the prefix drop out when shard boundaries change. Any recent batcher changes? @cheng

cheng: We flipped batcher.merge_on_the_fly=true two days ago to reduce tail latency. It resizes batching shards dynamically. I'll revert the flag on canary and rerun the nightly.

alex: Also check tokenizer changes from the quant PR — q4 models changed token alignment/padding which could cause off-by-one in cache indexing.

sam: Quick local experiment: disable merge_on_the_fly when ctx_len > 2048 and re-run. Failures drop to 2/200. Pushed a reproduction gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-4821 :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Canary rollback scheduled at 1752003600 if no objections. (This will revert merge_on_the_fly on canary only.)

maria: Good find. Keep running nightly with the revert + KV_CACHE_DEBUG enabled. I'll open issue ML-1247 and attach failing prompt IDs and sample outputs. Please add any extra failing sample ids to the thread. :pray:
